upload.description:
서른 번째 불합격 문자가 왔다.
'귀하의 역량은 훌륭하나'로 시작하는.

고시원 창문 너머 남의 집 불빛을 보며 라면 물이 끓는 동안 또 이력서를 씁니다.
전도서는 말합니다. 심을 때가 있고 거둘 때가 있다고.
나는 늦은 게 아니라, 아직 내 차례가 안 왔을 뿐입니다.

🎵 서른 번째 불합격 - MIDLIFE COMMUTER
💬 지금 '내 차례'를 기다리고 있는 누군가에게 한마디 남겨 주세요.

가사는 사람이 쓰고, 음악(ACE-Step)과 그림은 AI와 함께 만들었습니다.

scenes.plate: a narrow Korean gosiwon hallway at night seen at eye level, rows of identical small numbered doors on both sides, a long fluorescent ceiling light, a worn linoleum floor
scenes.motion: the young man stands still in the narrow hallway, the fluorescent light flickers softly, the hallway stays quiet and empty

scenes.plate: a tiny Korean gosiwon room at night seen at eye level, a narrow desk with a laptop and stacks of job-test books, many yellow sticky notes on the wall, a small desk lamp glowing, a narrow window
scenes.motion: the young man stands in the tiny room with a tired sigh, the desk lamp glows, the sticky notes flutter slightly

scenes.plate: a tiny Korean gosiwon room at night, a narrow desk with a laptop and stacks of books, sticky notes on the wall, dim lamp light
scenes.motion: the phone screen glows in the young man's hand, he stares down at it and his shoulders drop slowly, the lamp light flickers

scenes.plate: close view of a gosiwon desk corner at night, an open laptop showing an email page, a cup of instant coffee, crumpled paper, cold blue screen light
scenes.motion: the young man reads the message on his phone with a disappointed face, the laptop screen light flickers on his face, nothing else moves

scenes.plate: inside a tiny gosiwon room at night looking out through a small window, warm yellow lights glowing in the windows of an apartment building across the alley, a dark blue sky
scenes.motion: the young man stands still and looks out of the small window at the warm lights across the alley, a few window lights turn on and off

scenes.plate: a small shared gosiwon kitchen at night, a little pot of instant ramen boiling on a single electric stove, an open laptop on the narrow counter, a fluorescent light
scenes.motion: steam rises from the boiling ramen pot, the young man looks at the laptop screen with tired eyes, the fluorescent light hums

scenes.plate: the flat rooftop of a small Seoul building before dawn seen at eye level, a low railing, laundry lines, the city skyline under a deep blue sky turning pink at the horizon
scenes.motion: the young man looks up at the brightening dawn sky, the sky slowly turns pink and gold, the laundry sways in the wind

scenes.plate: a narrow farm road between golden rice paddies in the Korean countryside at sunrise, bundles of harvested rice on one side and green young sprouts in a seedbed on the other, low mountains behind
scenes.motion: the young man walks slowly along the farm road, the golden rice sways in the morning breeze, the sun rises over the mountains

scenes.plate: the top of the stairs at a Seoul subway station exit in the early morning seen at eye level, bright morning sunlight pouring in, a glass canopy, trees on the sidewalk
scenes.motion: the young man stands in the morning sunlight and smiles bravely, sunlight flickers through the leaves, the background stays calm

scenes.plate: a bare winter tree in a small Korean city park with many tiny new buds on its branches, soft golden morning sunlight, a clear pale blue sky
scenes.motion: the young man looks up at the tiny buds on the branches with a hopeful smile, the branches sway gently, sunlight sparkles

scenes.plate: the courtyard of a small traditional country house in Korea in the evening, a persimmon tree with orange fruit, a wooden porch (maru), warm light from the kitchen door
scenes.motion: the mother smiles warmly and nods gently as if listening to her son, the persimmon leaves sway, warm light glows from the door

scenes.plate: a wide pedestrian plaza in front of a tall glass office tower in Seoul on a bright morning, glass entrance doors, small trees in planters, no road
scenes.motion: the young man walks with steady steps across the plaza toward the glass doors, morning light reflects on the glass, the trees sway

scenes.plate: the flat rooftop of a small Seoul building at sunrise, a low railing, the sun rising between the city buildings, golden light and a few clouds
scenes.motion: the young man stands still facing the rising sun, golden light spreads across the city, clouds drift slowly
